task_plan.original_prompt: Build a modern Scientific Calculator web page in static/scientific_calculator.html featuring a dark glassmorphism theme, smooth button animations, standard arithmetic (+, -, *, /), trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan), logarithmic operations (log, ln), exponents (x^y, x^2), square root, calculation history tape, and full keyboard input support.
task_plan.summary: Develop a scientific calculator web page with a dark glassmorphism theme, supporting various mathematical operations and keyboard input.

steps.action_summary: Search for existing calculator projects and parse their HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code to identify reusable components and structures.
Create the basic HTML structure for the calculator, including the display screen, buttons, and calculation history tape, and implement smooth button animations using CSS.
Implement standard arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /), trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan), logarithmic operations (log, ln), exponents (x^y, x^2), and square root using JavaScript.
Add support for full keyboard input, allowing users to enter calculations using their keyboard.
Perform a security and quality audit of the calculator code, checking for potential vulnerabilities and ensuring adherence to best practices.
Write and execute pytest tests to verify the correctness and functionality of the calculator, covering various mathematical operations and input scenarios.
Generate documentation for the calculator, including a user guide and technical documentation, and create a PR summary highlighting the key features and changes.

review_result.summary: The provided code is a basic implementation of a scientific calculator. However, there are several areas that need improvement for better security, performance, and maintainability.

issues.description: The use of eval() function is a significant security risk as it can evaluate any JavaScript code. This can lead to code injection attacks.
issues.suggestion: Use a safer method to evaluate mathematical expressions, such as using a library or implementing a parser.

issues.description: The code has a lot of repeated event listeners for each button. This can be simplified and made more maintainable.
issues.suggestion: Use a loop to attach event listeners to the buttons, or use a more efficient method such as event delegation.

issues.description: The backspace function does not handle the case when the current expression is empty.
issues.suggestion: Add a check to prevent the backspace function from attempting to remove characters from an empty string.

issues.description: The code does not follow the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle. There are repeated lines of code for each button.
issues.suggestion: Extract the repeated code into a separate function to make it more maintainable and efficient.
